pm_active.meaning: executeHedge is called with PM active

blp_reserve_exists.meaning: BLP has an active reserve for the spot asset token

supplied_balance_reverts.meaning: querying 0x811 for a token never actually supplied to BLP produces a failure response causing suppliedBalance to revert

assumptions: executeHedge is the operation that registers the spot asset in vaultSupplied via notifyVaultSupply.
The spot asset token is the token queried from 0x811 during suppliedBalance accounting reads.

unresolved.description: Report does not state who may call executeHedge or whether the caller is unauthorized; the condition is limited to PM active and no BLP reserve.

limitations: Formalizes only the supplied_balance_reverts impact; downstream accounting read reverts and bricking are separate impacts.
The no-reserve condition is represented as a grounded Boolean because the report gives no numeric reserve definition.
